card.name: Freedom from burdens or obligations
card.fires_on: Words inside a phrase about not having to do something or being free from a duty, such as 'obligations of', 'have to', 'to support', 'pay rent', 'worry about'. It fires on the word just after the burden is introduced.

modes.label: Free from obligations
modes.description: The word right after an obligation noun or 'have to' in a statement that someone is relieved of a duty.
modes.example: free from the obligations<< of>> caring for young

modes.label: Verb after 'have to'
modes.description: The verb or object that follows 'do not have to' or 'doesn't have to', naming the burden that is absent.
modes.example: as they do not have to<< support>> their own weight

modes.label: Burden verb phrase
modes.description: A verb or preposition inside a phrase about a worry, cost or task one need not face.
modes.example: You don?t have to worry<< about>> your own machine lagging!

card.writes: It seems to push toward words naming duties, pressures or tasks to be dealt with, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up in sentences saying someone does not have to carry a burden, duty or cost.
